Subject: Follow-up: Pricing & Model Mix — BrightLayer discovery

Hi Erin / Jason —

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to hear more about BrightLayer's roadmap and where LLMs fit into the product. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can put together the right pricing/commit options: 

Recap (high level)
- Primary feature: conversational assistant embedded in the product (customer support + guided workflows) — this will drive the majority of chat volume.
- Embeddings: semantic search/recall for knowledge base + similarity matching for recommendations.
- Rerank: small percentage used to improve relevance in a few flows (A/B experiments initially).

Volume & model-mix questions (helpful for accurate unit economics):
1) Can you confirm estimated monthly token volumes per model type (chat / embeddings / rerank)? If you only have request counts, a ballpark avg tokens per request is fine (input + output).
2) For chat, what's a reasonable split between short support replies vs longer guided flows (approx avg tokens)?
3) Do you have a target unit economics / target $ per 1M tokens you’re aiming for (for budgeting)?
4) Any procurement constraints (preferred contract length, PO process, legal / SSO requirements)?

Attached is a short pricing scenarios workbook (redwood-pricing-scenarios.xlsx) showing hosted vs committed Dedicated curves — I filled in a couple of example mixes on tab 1. Based on what we discussed, if you can send the numbers above I'll run a few committed tiers and show target $/1M token outcomes and estimated monthly cost.

Next steps
- If you can reply with the volume estimates today/tomorrow we’ll get a tailored pricing & MRP (model mix pricing) back within 48 hours.
- Otherwise, happy to schedule a 30-min pricing follow-up next week to walk through scenarios live.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the follow-up and for the workbook — helpful. Below are the ballpark numbers from our side after a quick sync with Jason: 

Estimated monthly volumes (current pilot -> projected month 3):
- Chat (conversational assistant): 120M tokens/month (this assumes ~150k interactions; avg tokens per interaction ~800 total — ~300 input, ~500 output due to long guided flows).
- Embeddings (semantic search + recall): 30M tokens/month (we generate/update embeddings for KB and user content; avg 512 tokens per item).
- Rerank: 5M tokens/month (small percentage used on search results + experiments).

Budget / target unit economics:
- We're targeting a blended cost target of roughly $2,000 per 1M tokens at scale for hosted inference as a baseline for procurement (we know that's high-level; want committed pricing close to that number given target ARR and margins).
- Procurement: prefer a 12-month contract with a pilot PO first (pilot in Jan 2027, decision by end of Jan). We will need standard IP/security questionnaire answers and SOC2 evidence — Jason will coordinate with security.

If you can run the workbook with these numbers and show (a) hosted pay-as-you-go, (b) 12-mo committed tier, and (c) Dedicated tier estimates, that'd be perfect. Also interested in any guidance on model choices (lower-cost quantized variants for chat vs higher-quality for certain flows).

Thanks —
Erin
Director of Product, BrightLayer
erin.thompson@brightlayer.com | (212) 555-4466

Hi Erin / Jason —

Appreciate the quick numbers — that's exactly what we needed. Attached is a short SOW draft (SOW-draft.pdf) and I filled the pricing workbook with three scenarios based on the volumes you provided. High-level takeaways: 

1) Blended unit economics (examples based on your mix: chat 120M / embeddings 30M / rerank 5M)
- Hosted PAYG: ~$2,450 per 1M tokens (higher due to top-tier model selection for chat in default configs)
- 12-mo committed (moderate commit / 40% discount band): ~$1,550 per 1M tokens
- Dedicated (reserved capacity, predictable throughput): ~$1,100 per 1M tokens (requires commit & sizing)

Notes on model mix recommendations
- Chat: Recommend using our standard chat-large variant for the guided flows (higher quality) and a quantized chat-medium for short support replies to reduce cost. We can autoswitch by route to get better unit economics without sacrificing critical flows.
- Embeddings: Use the cost-optimized embeddings-v2 quantized profile for KB vectors; quality is comparable and much cheaper at scale.
- Rerank: Keep rerank on a smaller high-precision model; volume is low so it doesn't drive overall spend.

Next steps / asks
- Can you confirm the monthly volumes above (chat 120M / embeddings 30M / rerank 5M) as your planning numbers? If those look good I'll share a committed pricing proposal and a mutual action plan (timeline + milestones).
- I've attached a short SOW-draft to help scope the pilot (pilot: 8 weeks, success metrics: latency < 300ms p95, accuracy targets on 3 prompt sets).
- Security: Dev will send our SOC2 documentation and our questionnaire answers by end of day tomorrow.
- Proposed time to review pricing and SOW: Thu 11/26 10:30am PT — does that work for you?

If you confirm volumes I'll drop the committed tier numbers into a quick DocuSign-ready summary and include a 12-mo and 24-mo commit option so you can see the delta by term.

Thanks again — looking forward to moving this to pilot.

Best,
Marissa
